title: Endline open cloze
instructions: Supply one word for each gap. Complete all five before submitting the protected form.

parts.prompt: Gap 1: supply the indefinite article required before “inexpensive rain gauge”.

response.rationale: Inexpensive begins with a vowel sound, so the singular noun phrase takes an.

parts.hint: Protected endline: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Use “an” before a singular count noun beginning with a vowel sound.

parts.prompt: Gap 2: supply the relative pronoun linking the locations to “were away from roofs”.

response.rationale: Which or that introduces the defining relative clause describing locations.

parts.hint: Protected endline: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: “Which” links the locations to the clause that describes them; “that” is also acceptable.

parts.prompt: Gap 3: supply the conjunction showing that different readings occurred despite identical containers.

response.rationale: Although introduces a concession between identical equipment and different results.

parts.hint: Protected endline: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: “Although” marks the contrast between a shared method and varying readings.

parts.prompt: Gap 4: supply the determiner showing that every team checked its own single gauge.

response.rationale: Its refers to the singular collective noun team; singular they/their is also accepted.

parts.hint: Protected endline: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: “Its” shows possession by each team; “their” is accepted in contemporary usage.

parts.prompt: Gap 5: supply the preposition marking the comparison as earlier than the presentation.

response.rationale: The records were compared before the findings were presented.

parts.hint: Protected endline: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: “Before” establishes the required order of events.
